To pass the `skill-help` PR check (`scripts/check-skill-help.sh`), every `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` must end with a `## Help` section. The body of that section must be fenced by `<!-- lore-help:begin -->` and `<!-- lore-help:end -->`, each on its own line. The check matches these markers anchored to the start of a line, so mid-sentence mentions don't count.

Inside the fenced block, `**Summary.**` and `**Usage:**` are required. `**Use when.**`, `**Not for.**`, `**Examples**` and `**Related:**` are optional. The check fails if the block is missing or malformed. The sources don't spell out which kinds of malformation it catches.
